title: Business Security Deposit: Paying an Additional Deposit
content:
An additional deposit owed after a recalculation raised the requirement of a business Security Deposit is paid by the customer directly to the deposit, in installments numbered on from the deposit's latest installment number, so that no installment number is recorded twice on the deposit.

**Condition on the deposit record.** The installment of an additional deposit is worked out only after the deposit shows its raised required amount and has returned to assessed status.

Stated the other way: while the deposit still shows its earlier required amount, or still stands in held status, the installment of an additional deposit is not worked out.

**Raised requirement and due period.** When a recalculated amount exceeds the held cash by more than the kind's increase threshold of the held cash, the deposit returns to assessed with the raised required amount, and the difference due within the kind's additional-deposit period is the additional amount due on the deposit.

## Installment numbering (hypothetical deposits)

| Latest installment number on the deposit | Numbers of the additional installments |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2, 3, ... |
| 2 | 3, 4, ... |
| 3 | 4, 5, ... |

## Paying the installment: `pay_additional_deposit_64b1dc0d`

**Capability.** The tool pays, as the customer, an installment of the additional amount owed on a business Security Deposit whose requirement was raised. It books a cash deposit payment received today on the deposit under the stated installment number, records on the deposit the number of installments in which the additional amount is being paid, and raises the cash and interest held on the deposit by the amount paid. The payment then appears among the deposit's transactions, and the deposit shows the installment count and the new held amount.

**How it is invoked.** It is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `deposit_id` | The deposit reference number of the deposit being paid, as given to the customer from the security-deposit lookup | Reference number |
| `installment_number` | The installment number this payment satisfies on the deposit | Integer counting from 1 for the deposit's earliest installment |
| `installment_count` | The number of installments in which the additional amount is being paid | Positive integer |
| `amount` | The amount paid | USD with 2 decimal places, a positive amount rounded to the cent |

**Return.** A one-line text receipt naming the new deposit transaction reference number, the installment number and the installment count, the amount received in USD with 2 decimal places, the deposit and the resulting held amount; the transaction reference number in the receipt confirms the payment was received.
